notes.title: FREEFLOW U6.5, The "Half Way" Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I know there hasn't been any updates for a long while now, however I had some family issues that prevented me from properly working on FREEFLOW so I haven't been able to work on U7 much.

Anyway, lets get into the...

PATCH NOTES:


Added


Added Level 9

Added Level 10

Added Secret Level for chapter 2

Added "Music Volume" to the settings

Added a display to show what graphics setting you are on, as its hard to tell.

Re-added the FPS Limiter as now it actually works.


Removed


Nothing


Known Bugs


Secret Level for chapter 2 tends to break UI. Reason, unknown. Fix, restart game

Graphics display may break on a game restart. Reason, unknown. Fix, click the option again.

Pause menu buttons may not work in a certain area. Reason, known but unfixed as of this update. Fix, click on the far edges of the buttons.

REPORT ANY BUGS TO THE DISCORD SERVER, IN THE BUG-HUNTERS CHANNEL


Enjoy the update!

notes.title: U6.3, The "Graphics" Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I've been pumping out loads of updates recently. Not sure why but yeah. Anyway, for the people who want to know, here are the...



PATCH NOTES:

Added Graphics settings, now you can choose between High, Medium and Low.

Added seperate audio sliders

Uncapped FPS

Added SceneOnKey, press Z to go back to Tutorial

Updated how the hyperlinks work

Disabled the hyperlink screen when in Options or Credits

Moved stuff around in the options menu



And a few other things....


Next update might take a while, I plan for the next update to actually have new levels lol.


Enjoy!

notes.title: U6.2, "The Music Patch... 2!"
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! New patch is here. Very small patch but still a pretty good one. Lets get right to the...



PATCH NOTES:


Added music, including: 

FREEFLOW Main Theme - Benjib20 
Submersus - Ilves15
The ShozzaRap - Shozzakai

Updated the radio to make it a TV

Added the ShozzaButton

Upgraded the credits to include the track names AND gave Shozzakai a hyperlink (go sub he just needs 5 subs gang)




Aaaaand I think thats everything...

Enjoy!

notes.title: U5.3, "The Texture Update"
notes.notes:
Hello all! Update time, here's the patch notes for today.

THE PATCH NOTES:


Updated all the main facility textures to a homemade one by yours truly.

Updated all the Office textures to make them more distinct.

Added much more office areas in Tutorial, Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 to explore.

Added the Room of Quotes (let me know on discord when you find it!)

Added hyperlinks to the main menu.

Gave the grappler a pull force


Etc etc...



Enjoy the update everyone!

notes.title: Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

You all might be wondering something like "what day is this game gonna release?"

Well I got the answer! The official release date for the steam version will be November 13th because of steam saying I gotta wait 2 weeks.
